description: This file defines a color dialog plugin for CKEditor, including UI elements, color table creation, and event handling for color selection.

methods.name: clearSelected
methods.description: Clears the selected color highlight and resets the color input.

methods.name: updateSelected
methods.description: Updates the selected color based on user interaction.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Highlights the color cell when hovered.

methods.name: createColorTable
methods.description: Generates the color palette table with color cells.
